Captain cosmic plays the construct that allows a player to gain the power to do 3 energy damage and gives it to Mr. Fixer. Does this mean he could still use his strike ability at least once or must the power used be the strike ability to use the strike a second time.

posts.raw: He gets to use the power from Cosmic Weapon as his initial power use and then Overdrive allows you to still use the Strike power twice.

posts.name: Ario
posts.cooked:
From previous rulings (http://www.boardgamegeek.com/thread/1292511/fixers-overdrive-and-extrapowers) Mr. Fixer could actually use Cosmic Weapon and then use Strike twice, for three powers that turn. Since the card says he can Strike twice in the turn, if he uses Cosmic Weapon in his power phase, then Overdrive still says he can use Strike twice. 

The same goes for Rod of Anubis and Micro-Assembler.

posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
If I am remembering it correctly extra power granting in the online game works as so:

1.  Granted extra power.

2.  If the hero has a power phase coming this turn, resolve extra power(s) then.

3.  If the hero does not have a power phase this turn they must use the powers immediately or not at all.

 

This works really well within the intent of the cards.

As to the "may" in Overdrive, I can see that argument, but the key is that the granted power wording has no relationship with your power phase or normal power use, it doesn't work at all like Pride and Prejudice, which requires a power use first to grant the second power.

If Overdrive was worded

If you use Strike this turn you may use it again for free.

Then the choice would be use strike twice or use a different power.  It would also not grant out of turn power uses.
